map.TOML 解析：去回车后逐行处理，跳过空行与 # 开头注释（# 判定避开成对双引: TOML parsing: after removing carriage returns, process line by line, skipping blank lines and lines starting with # (the # check avoids being inside a paired double quote); [section] builds nested objects level by level on ., and [[array name]] appends a new element to the array of that name; other lines split at the first = into key and value, where the value first has its trailing # comment stripped and is then parsed — double-quoted strings are unescaped for \n \t \", true/false become booleans, pure integers use parseInt, pure decimals use parseFloat, and [ ] contents are parsed recursively comma-separated into arrays. XML conversion: object values restore @-prefixed keys as attributes and #text as text, arrays are serialized as same-named elements one by one; when there is more than one top-level key the result is wrapped in <root>, and & < > and double quotes in attribute values are escaped
